copy.tagline: 用 Flutter 构建跨平台应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在用 Flutter 开发跨平台应用
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building cross-platform apps with Flutter

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会作为 Flutter 专家，帮你生成跨平台应用代码：编写界面组件、配置状态管理（Riverpod/Bloc）、设置 GoRouter 路由，并给出测试与性能优化建议。
howto.when: 当你提到 Flutter、Dart、widget 等关键词，或要求进行跨平台开发、状态管理、路由配置等 Flutter 相关任务时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Riverpod 写一个计数器状态管理
用 GoRouter 给应用配置页面路由和深链接
say.note: 会给出路由配置代码和导航示例

say.text: Flutter 列表滑动卡顿，怎么定位和优化？
say.note: 会指导用 DevTools 分析并修复

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as a Flutter expert, generating cross-platform app code: building UI widgets, configuring state management (Riverpod/Bloc), setting up GoRouter navigation, and providing testing and performance optimization advice.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like Flutter, Dart, widget, or request cross-platform development, state management, routing configuration, or other Flutter-related tasks.

say_en.text: Help me write a counter state management with Riverpod
Configure page routing and deep links with GoRouter for my app
say_en.note: Provides route config and navigation examples

say_en.text: My Flutter list is laggy when scrolling, how to locate and fix it?
say_en.note: Guides profiling with DevTools and fixing
